# 8551 - TRI-STATE quad D-type register (bus register)

Package DIP-16 · family 8000 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/8551.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/8551.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 50 |
|---|
| ![8551 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/8551.png) |

No drawn shape for this chip has been made yet (no file `catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-8551.png`, `catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-8551.png`).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | M | enable | low |  | controls pins 3, 4, 5, 6; when not enabled: float |
| 2 | N | enable | low |  | controls pins 3, 4, 5, 6; when not enabled: float |
| 3 | Q1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by M,N |
| 4 | Q2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by M,N |
| 5 | Q3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by M,N |
| 6 | Q4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by M,N |
| 7 | CLOCK | clock |  |  | rising edge |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | G1 | input |  |  |  |
| 10 | G2 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | D4 | input |  |  |  |
| 12 | D3 | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | D2 | input |  |  |  |
| 14 | D1 | input |  |  |  |
| 15 | CLEAR | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked) |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3,4,5,6 | Qn = stored bit n when M' AND N'; Z when M OR N | Each Q shows its flip-flop while M and N are both low; if either is high the outputs float. The flip-flops keep working while the outputs float. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- CLEAR high: all four bits = 0 at once
- CLEAR low, G1 and G2 both low: bit n = Dn at the rising CLOCK edge
- CLEAR low, G1 or G2 high: bits hold at the clock edge
- CLOCK low: bits hold

## Not known

- Enable/disable times: the text layer gives three numbers for the 51 column; read as min/typ/max, not checked against the page image.
- Setup/hold/pulse-width figures read as minimums from the DM75/85 51 column.

## Notes

Same function as 74173. Data enable (G1, G2) and output control (M, N) are separate.
